meta.title: Natural Earth populated places
meta.schema: features[]: name, lat, lon, population (pop_max, the row's largest published figure; 0 where the source is unknown), country (adm0name), region (adm1name, null where the source has none), scale (scalerank: Natural Earth's label prominence for the place, lower is more prominent), iso (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3), iso2, adm1code? (the subdivision's two-letter code from the admin-1 source: 'MO', 'ON', 'BY'; absent where the source has no code for the region), id
meta.approximate: A POINT, NOT AN OUTLINE. ne_10m_populated_places_simple carries no city geometry, so this pack cannot say where a city ends. Isolating to a city means a box scaled by population around this point; that box is an estimate, not a boundary.
